metadata.description: Android app giving one newspaper deliverer a street-by-street overview of which addresses receive the newspaper and/or leaflets, based on mailbox stickers.

milestones.title: Preparation (plan Phase 0)
milestones.notes: Wireframes approved. Remaining: walk the real route once to note stickers and walking order (user).

milestones.title: MVP: a round can be walked (end of Phase 3)
milestones.notes: Exit: a full round can be walked with the live list (check-offs dropped, DEC-014).

milestones.title: Validated in the field (Phase 5)
milestones.notes: Two consecutive weeks without a wrong delivery caused by the app.

milestones.title: v1.0 release (Phase 7)
milestones.notes: Dutch translation review, final signed APK, limited-distribution developer verification registered before the 2027 global rollout.

features.title: Domain rules with full unit tests
features.description: Pure Kotlin domain functions: deliveryFor(sticker), deliveryFor(address, round), generateRange, generateUnits, natural suffix sort, address sort with direction, buildingSummary. No Android dependencies.
acceptance_criteria: Every row of the sticker table (§3.3) covered by tests
Non-existing address always yields nothing; round without leaflets yields no leaflets
Range cases: 2-24 even, 1-24 even starts at 2, from == to, single-sided
Sorting: 12, 12A, 12B, 13; natural suffix sort 1, 2, 10; descending direction
Units: A-L = 12, A-Z = 26, 1-20 numeric
domain package has no android.* imports

done: domain.model: Sticker, Delivery, RoundContents, Side, Direction, Address, SuffixType
domain.rules: deliveryFor(sticker), deliveryFor(address, round), generateRange/checkRange/countInRange, generateUnits, NaturalOrder/AddressNumberOrder/inWalkingOrder, stickerSummary/deliverySummary
68 unit tests passing (JUnit Jupiter); mutation check: breaking NEE_JA rule and adding android import both fail tests
DomainPurityTest enforces no android/androidx/dagger imports in domain
DEC-012 revised per user: ranges low to high only; reverse walking = per-segment checkbox
notes: 'Building done' + undo tests (plan §10) belong to RND-D, since they need RoundItems
generateUnits throws on invalid input; BLD-01 will add a checkUnits() for UI messages, like checkRange()

features.title: First-launch wizard and home screen
features.description: Four-step guided setup (nickname, route + town, street sections loop, walking order) reusing the section/number-check screens, then home screen with route name, sticker overview entry and Start round button.
acceptance_criteria: See plan ADR-01
Phase 2 exit: the real route, including buildings, can be entered in under 45 minutes (user test)

features.title: Start round: live list with take-along counts
features.description: 'Start round' opens the round list directly (no contents choice, DEC-019). Counts of newspapers and leaflets for the whole route are shown at the top, calculated live from the addresses (deliverySummary with FullRound). Nothing is stored per round (DEC-014).
acceptance_criteria: Start round opens the walking list without extra steps
Header shows newspapers and leaflets to take along; counts match the existing addresses (does-not-exist and NEE/NEE excluded as per rules)
notes: RND-01 dropped (DEC-019). Simplify nav: remove RoundStart placeholder; RoundMode becomes a data object

features.title: Round list in walking order (live)
features.description: Live list of addresses grouped by segment in walking order with four distinct delivery states (icon + colour); skipped houses dimmed with toggle; non-existing hidden by default; screen kept on. Always reflects current route data (DEC-014).
acceptance_criteria: See plan RND-03, RND-04, RND-08; smooth scroll with 1,000 addresses

features.title: Check-off, progress and persistence

features.title: Buildings in round mode (row + direct zoom-in)
